summary: Controlled re-entry peak: one sweet-spot quality session on the bike, aerobic base ride, conservative strength re-entry, and an easy run to re-introduce impact loading — the week's stimulus before next week's recovery drop

sessions.name: Aerobic Base Ride
sessions.focus: Re-establish aerobic base and fat-oxidation stimulus at Z2 after deload period; mitochondrial density without tissue overload

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, 70–100W, cadence 80–90 rpm — wake legs up gradually, no pressure
Z2 aerobic base, 106–141W, cadence 85–95 rpm, conversational effort, HR 146–162 bpm — if HR drifts above 162 bpm ease off watts
Z1 easy spin, drop HR below 130 bpm before stopping

sessions.name: Sweet-Spot 3×5min
sessions.focus: Sweet-spot training at 88–95% FTP drives high-end aerobic adaptation and FTP development; highest-quality stimulus achievable in 30 min after layoff

steps.description: Progressive build: 2 min Z1 70–100W → 2 min Z2 110–130W → 2 min Z3 142–155W; cadence 85–90 rpm throughout
Sweet-spot Z3–Z4 boundary, 156–168W (88–95% FTP), cadence 90+ rpm, HR 163–175 bpm — keep watts even, avoid surging
Z1 easy spin, 70–90W — let HR drop back toward 145 bpm before next rep
Z1 easy spin, reduce HR below 130 bpm, pedal lightly

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Re-Entry
sessions.focus: Posterior chain and single-leg strength to support cycling mechanics and metabolic health; conservative 2-round re-entry after deload, shoulder-modified throughout
sessions.notes: 2 rounds: Goblet Squat 12 reps @ 16 kg → RDL 10 reps @ 16 kg (both hands) → TRX Split Squat 10 reps per leg (bodyweight) → Banded Glute Bridge 15 reps → Forearm Plank 40s hold. Rest 60s between exercises, 90s between rounds. RIR 2–3 on all loaded moves. Zero overhead loading — shoulder fully protected.

steps.description: Leg swings 10 reps each direction per side, hip circles 10 each direction, bodyweight squats 15 slow reps with 2s pause at bottom

2 rounds: Goblet Squat 12 reps @ 16 kg → Romanian Deadlift 10 reps @ 16 kg → TRX Split Squat 10 reps per leg (BW) → Banded Glute Bridge 15 reps → Forearm Plank 40s. Rest 60s between exercises, 90s between rounds
Hip flexor stretch 30s per side, supine hamstring stretch 30s per side, figure-four glute stretch 30s per side, child's pose 45s

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Run
sessions.focus: Tissue loading and aerobic continuity via Z1–Z2 easy running; re-introduces impact and eccentric leg loading gradually after deload, supports fat oxidation

steps.description: 3 min brisk walk → 2 min very easy jog building to Z1; HR below 145 bpm; include leg swings, ankle circles, slow high knees
Z1–Z2 easy continuous run, > 6:45/km, HR 130–162 bpm — if HR climbs toward 162 bpm slow down or walk briefly; flat terrain, no hills
Easy walk to bring HR below 120 bpm before stopping
